# Blanko Website Starter

This is a neutral PHP website starter for an AI website-building workshop.

## Important context
- The technical shell is already prepared: routing, shared header/footer, local assets, security headers, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and placeholder pages exist.
- The visible website intentionally has no finished content, no real images and no organization-specific copy.
- Future AI agents should focus on frontend content, layout, visual design, CSS and appropriate image assets.

## Main files
- `router.php`: extensionless routing for public pages.
- `.htaccess`: Apache security, redirects, caching and router forwarding.
- `config/config.php`: neutral site settings and environment defaults.
- `includes/header.php` and `includes/footer.php`: shared layout shell.
- `pages/`: public placeholder pages.
- `assets/css/style.css`: neutral starter CSS.

## Before publishing
- Replace `https://example.com` in `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt`.
- Update `SITE_URL`, `SITE_NAME`, `CONTACT_EMAIL`, `LOCATION_SHORT` and `LOCATION_FULL`.
- Replace legal placeholder pages with correct legal content.
- Add extra public pages only when the user's actual website concept requires them.
- Add real images only after deciding the website topic and visual direction.
